title: Designated Inter-Agency & External Communications Concerning Special Prosecutor Selection ("Cornell 7" Case) (Office of the Attorney General - New York)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law (N.Y. Pub. Off. Law §§ 84–90), I hereby request copies of public records maintained by your agency regarding the selection, appointment, and scope of Attorney General Letitia James as Special Prosecutor in the "Cornell 7" case.
Timeframe:
This request is strictly limited to records created, sent, received, or modified from September 1, 2026, through the date of this request.
Requested Records:
Executive Chamber & OAG Liaison Communications: All emails, instant messages, and formal correspondence exchanged between designated intergovernmental, legislative, or agency liaisons within the Executive Chamber and their counterparts within the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) concerning the decision to appoint or designate Attorney General James as Special Prosecutor pursuant to Executive Law § 63.
Tompkins County District Attorney Communications: All correspondence (including emails, letters, formal notices, and attachments) exchanged between your agency and the Tompkins County District Attorney’s Office (including DA Matthew Van Houten, chief assistant DAs, or staff liaisons) concerning the transfer of jurisdiction, referral, or reassignment of the "Cornell 7" matter.
Calendar Entries & Meeting Logs: All calendar entries, Outlook/Google scheduling invitations, meeting agendas, and attendee lists for meetings, briefings, or conference calls involving leadership or staff from:
1.	The Executive Chamber and OAG; or
2.	Your agency and the Tompkins County District Attorney’s Office, where the designation or assignment of a Special Prosecutor for the "Cornell 7" case was on the agenda or discussed.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Carlos Gamez

title: Yuma County ME: Data on Suspected Border Crosser and Unidentified Decedents, 2014–Present (Yuma County Sheriff's Office)

communications.subject: Arizona Public Records Law Request: Yuma County ME: Data on Suspected Border Crosser and Unidentified Decedents, 2014–Present (Yuma County Sheriff's Office)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

I request an electronic export (CSV or Excel) from the Yuma County Office of the Medical Examiner’s case-management system covering all decedents reported to or examined by the office between January 1, 2014 and the date this request is processed who meet any of the following criteria: (a) suspected or confirmed undocumented border crossers (UBCs); (b) nationality recorded as other than U.S.; or (c) unidentified at the time of examination or at present. For each case I request the fields listed below, along with any data dictionary or codebook for these fields. I am not requesting autopsy reports, photographs, or full case files.
- Medical examiner case number
- External report/case number/s
- Name of decedent (where releasable) 
- Date of death
- Date of discovery
- Latitude of recovery
- Longitude of recovery
- Location of recovery (descriptive)
- Manner of death
- Cause of death
- Age (or estimated age range)
- Sex
- Nationality
- Identification status
- Reporting and/or recovering agency
- Condition of remains
- Disposition of remains
- Whether an autopsy was performed
- Date and method of identification

Please note that the requested records are for use in noncommercial academic research. I am happy to accept records on a rolling basis and to discuss narrowing the request if it is burdensome. If any fields are withheld or redacted, please identify them and cite the legal basis.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Zoe Sigman

title: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Records - Suzanne Morphew Homicide Investigation

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act (CORA) (C.R.S. § 24-72-201 et seq.) and Colorado Criminal Justice Records Act (CCJRA), I hereby request access to and copies of public records regarding the homicide investigation of Suzanne Morphew (disappeared May 10, 2020, near Salida, CO).

Specifically, I am requesting the following:

Initial incident reports, dispatch logs, and crime scene search summaries regarding the May 10, 2020 report of her disappearance.

Body-worn camera (BWC) and dashcam footage recorded by deputies during the initial search near Highway 50 and the recovery of the mountain bike and helmet.

Released press releases, booking records, and public case summaries regarding the arrest and investigation of Barry Morphew.

Audio recordings and transcripts of any 911 calls related to her disappearance or initial search.

If any portion of this request is denied or redacted, please provide a written response citing the specific statutory exemptions under CORA/CCJRA.

If processing fees are estimated to exceed $20.00, please notify me in advance with an itemized estimate. I prefer to receive all records electronically via email attachment or secure online download.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lina Biiska
